name: hurtigrutensvalbard.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But SPF needs more than 10 DNS lookups, so it fails everywhere.
lesson: Fix the first security item in the report, then run the review again.
summary: hurtigrutensvalbard.com scores 53 out of 100 (F). 8 checks fail now, 33 are at risk, and 36 pass. Fix first: SPF needs more than 10 DNS lookups, so it fails everywhere.

fix.title: SPF needs more than 10 DNS lookups, so it fails everywhere
fix.evidence: hurtigrutensvalbard.com's SPF record needs 20 DNS lookups, counting every include, a, mx, ptr, exists and redirect inside each include. Receivers stop at 10 and treat SPF as an error (permerror), so mail from the domain fails SPF and passes DMARC only when…
fix.fix: Bring it to 10 or fewer, starting with what costs the most: include:oracleindustry.com (11 lookups), include:_spf.travelize.se (2 lookups) and include:spf.sabre.com (2 lookups). Remove includes for services that no…

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: Cookiebot was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw LinkedIn Insight (2 requests), Google Ads (1 request), and cookies _gcl_au, bcookie on linkedin.com, li_gc on linkedin.com, lidc on linkedin.com, __hstc, hubspotutk.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: 2 SPF includes point at domains with no SPF record
fix.evidence: hurtigrutensvalbard.com's SPF record includes include:smtp.fra.icprod.oracleindustry.com and include:gcp-prodpci.synxis.com, and no single v=spf1 record answers there. Receivers treat that as an error (permerror), so SPF fails for every message.
fix.fix: Remove includes for services you no longer use, and correct the others to the address your mail provider lists today.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: Tracking continues after Reject
fix.evidence: After pressing "Reject All" and reloading, LinkedIn Insight (6 requests) still appeared.
fix.fix: Map every tag in the consent tool to a category and block it until that category is accepted.

fix.title: Scripts fingerprint the browser before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: Cookiebot was showing. Before any choice, js-eu1.hs-analytics.net drew hidden text on a canvas and read it back, measured which fonts are installed, and rendered a silent audio tone. Read together, these give the browser an ID that survives clearing cookies.
fix.fix: Find the tag behind each host and hold it until consent, like a tracking cookie. If it is fraud or bot protection, name it in the privacy notice.
